source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: For a **Leadership roll**, the unit’s controller rolls 2D6. It passes if the total equals or beats at least 1 [Leadership characteristic](vsdata:core-rule/profiles) among the unit’s models, and fails otherwise; the rule calling for the roll says what each result does. A Leadership test is the same roll.

printedMechanics.threshold: any one of the Ld characteristics in the unit
printedMechanics.passOn: total >= at least one Ld characteristic in the unit
printedMechanics.failOn: total < every Ld characteristic in the unit
printedMechanics.effects: set by the rule that calls for the roll
